# Benchmark for UCAN in HTTP header size

This repo simply creates a typical UCAN HTTP header for a `/content/retrieve` invocation to illustrate the header size with an increasing delegation chain length.

The invocation and delegation chain are added to a UCAN container, Gzipped and Base64 encoded and then measured for size.

Typically HTTP header limits are set at 8KB, but notably nginx uses the system page size by default, which is 4KB on most systems. A server will return `413 Entity Too Large` if headers size exceeds that limit.

Source: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/686217/maximum-on-http-header-values
